headline: Earnings hold up year over year despite a seasonal dip
summary_short: Dollar Tree reported revenue of $4.98B (-8.7% q/q, +7.2% y/y) and net income of $347.3M (-31.4% q/q, +1.1% y/y) for the period; diluted EPS was $1.76, down 30.4% q/q but up 9.3% y/y.
summary_long: Revenue was $4.98B, down 8.7% q/q off a seasonally stronger prior quarter and up 7.2% y/y. Gross profit was $1.83B (-14.1% q/q, +11.0% y/y). Operating income was $473.3M (-31.9% q/q, +23.2% y/y). EBITDA was $655.7M (-24.2% q/q, +9.9% y/y). Net income was $347.3M (-31.4% q/q, +1.1% y/y). Diluted EPS was $1.76 (-30.4% q/q, +9.3% y/y). No cash-position or balance-sheet figures are available on the verified shard for this period.
